abstract: Objective This study aimed to explore the diagnostic and prognostic significance of integrating classical tumor markers, including alpha-fetoprotein (AFP), beta-human chorionic gonadotropin (β-HCG), and lactate dehydrogenase (LDH), with inflammatory hematological indices, including neutrophil-to-lymphocyte ratio (NLR) and mean platelet volume-to-platelet ratio (MPV/PLT), in patients with testicular neoplasms. Materials and methods This retrospective study included 85 patients with histologically confirmed testicular tumors (48 seminomas and 37 nonseminomas). Preoperative serum AFP, β-HCG, and LDH levels were analyzed along with the complete blood count parameters. The derived inflammatory indices (NLR and MPV/PLT) were calculated. Intergroup comparisons were performed using the Student's t-test or Mann-Whitney U test, and correlations between tumor markers and inflammatory indices were assessed using Spearman's analysis. Results The mean age did not differ significantly between the seminoma (37.5 ± 10.1 years) and non-seminoma (35.3 ± 9.2 years) groups (p > 0.05). Serum AFP and β-HCG levels were markedly elevated in non-seminoma patients (AFP: 87.24 ± 28.29 ng/mL vs. 2.58 ± 0.27 ng/mL; β-HCG: 81.45 ± 31 IU/L vs. 2.55 ± 0.76 IU/L, p < 0.01 for both). LDH levels exhibited a similar trend. Inflammatory indices (NLR and MPV/PLT) were higher in non-seminoma cases and showed positive correlations with AFP and β-HCG, suggesting a link between systemic inflammation and tumor activity. Conclusion Combining classical tumor markers with simple hematological indices offers an expanded perspective on the tumor biology of testicular cancer. NLR and MPV/PLT may serve as complementary markers for tumor aggressiveness and systemic inflammatory response, potentially improving risk stratification and follow-up strategies.
abstract_ja: 目的：本研究は、古典的な腫瘍マーカー（αフェトプロテイン（AFP）、β-HCG、乳酸脱水素酵素（LDH））と、炎症性血液指標（好中球リンパ球比（NLR）および平均血小板容積/血小板比（MPV/PLT））を統合することの、精巣腫瘍患者における診断的・予後的意義を検討することを目的とした。対象と方法：組織学的に確定した精巣腫瘍患者85例（セミノーマ48例、非セミノーマ37例）を対象とした後方視的研究である。術前の血清AFP、β-HCG、LDH値を、全血球計算の各パラメータとともに解析した。炎症指標（NLRおよびMPV/PLT）を算出した。群間比較はStudentのt検定またはMann-WhitneyのU検定を用い、腫瘍マーカーと炎症指標の相関はSpearman解析で評価した。結果：セミノーマ群（37.5±10.1歳）と非セミノーマ群（35.3±9.2歳）で年齢に有意差はなかった（p>0.05）。血清AFPおよびβ-HCG値は非セミノーマ患者で著明に高値であった（AFP：87.24±28.29 ng/mL対2.58±0.27 ng/mL、β-HCG：81.45±31 IU/L対2.55±0.76 IU/L、いずれもp<0.01）。LDH値も同様の傾向を示した。NLRおよびMPV/PLTは非セミノーマ症例で高く、AFPおよびβ-HCGと正の相関を示し、全身性炎症と腫瘍活動性の関連が示唆された。結論：古典的な腫瘍マーカーと簡便な血液学的指標を組み合わせることで、精巣がんの腫瘍生物学についてより広い視点が得られる。NLRとMPV/PLTは腫瘍の悪性度と全身性炎症反応の補助マーカーとなり、リスク層別化やフォローアップ戦略を改善する可能性がある。
